title: Craftable totems!
description: A simple lightweight datapack that adds a recipe for totem of undying that is balanced but u can get it early!
body:
A lightweight datapack that adds a recipe for totem of undying!
Tired of searching craftable totems datapack for your hardcore forever world? Every datapack you see is either old or has really hard recipes? Well i got u! The recipe is really easy! 2 emeralds 6 gold ingots and a golden block, boom you got yourself a life saver!![Totem recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3fd7b088e38abf2faad91eb8c19479ea101e686.jpeg)
